messages:
Mira Patel: Heads up — the AWQ group_size sweep from yesterday is causing flakiness on canary. Saw ~0.8% 5xx rate and a few NaNs in outputs on model-x-2.0 when group_size >= 256.
Jonas K.: ugh. any stack traces or logs? seems high for a config change.
Mira Patel: paste from runtime: ```2026-03-30T14:02:11Z ERROR serve: forward: runtime panic: index out of range
model=model-x-2.0 group_size=512 act_quant=true batch=4 seq=2048```
Arjun Singh: that stack looks like KV-cache / grouping mismatch. We saw similar when act_quant enabled with large groups -> some kernels assume smaller group length.
Sylvia Ramos: Also noticed memory spikes on p4d canaries, OOM near token 600. Could be accumulation in cached keys when group_size triggers different tiling.
Jonas K.: repro plan: run micro-bench with batch=1..8 seq=1024/2048, toggle act_quant, vary group_size [64,128,256,512], and enable KV consistency check. I'll spin up 2 nodes.
Mira Patel: started a quick run: job/1769801234-awq-repro. logs: small eval prompts produce NaN on 3/200 samples when act_quant=true and group_size=256. act_quant=false seems stable.
Arjun Singh: can you dump first-token logits and kv-shapes? if shapes mismatch we can detect kernel fallback path.
Mira Patel: uploaded trace to s3: s3://rf-inference-tests/awq/1769801234/trace.tar.gz. includes kv-shapes and per-layer stats.
Sylvia Ramos: hypothesis: AWQ act-quant interacts with grouped weight packing leading to sign-bit compression errors for some layers at large group_size. That can produce Inf/NaN downstream.
Jonas K.: mitigation for canary: pin group_size=64 and force act_quant=false for now. Also add rollout rule to fallback to GPTQ if failure_rate > 0.2% for 10m.
ci-bot: Triggered job: ci/evals/awq-stability/1769801234 — started.
Arjun Singh: long-term fix options: add per-group checksum at compile time, tighten numeric clamping after dequant, or revise act-quant accumulator to use 32-bit mid-accumulation for edge groups. I'll prototype clamp.
Mira Patel: noted. Will run the sweep with pinned group_size 64 across canaries and run a targeted AB with GPTQ baseline. collecting accuracy deltas vs testset (huge-prompts set).
Jonas K.: FYI: results so far: AWQ(group=64,act=false) accuracy -0.3% vs fp16; AWQ(group=256,act=true) accuracy -0.7% but with instability. GPTQ baseline = -0.2%. We'll share numeric tables once runs finish.
Sylvia Ramos: adding monitoring alerts: increase sampling of logits for drift detection and enable automatic rollback if NaN count > 1 per 10k tokens.
Mira Patel: thanks — I'll update the rollout doc and mark the canary as paused until rollback rules in place.
Jonas K.: if anyone wants to help validate, ping me and I'll share the repro cluster creds.
Arjun Singh: I'll start the clamp patch PR and unit tests for extreme group sizes.
Mira Patel: cheers, everyone. :thumbsup:
